operations.name: T. Jefferson Shreve

expected.charges: Aiding the Confederacy (guiding the Confederate Army on the Potomac)

operations.research_note: Handy printed pp288–290, February26,1864 entry lists Shreve (OCR Shrove) among twelve called for oath and release. Calls them released, at liberty, but only Gibson physically left island that day due weather. Add supported February1864 release month, no exact departure day inferred. Shreve named repeatedly before this entry and not conflated with other prisoner. Initial admission unresolved; bio/photo/notes preserved.
